MOTION_COLD_POOL=262144 (test 14 row 17): cold motion keys share the pressure pool, 0 disc reads in play
area: Rooms whose enemy animations did not fit in memory: the farm (r103, measured), also at risk r117, r119, r11d, r11e
plain: Enemy animations were being re-read from the disc in the middle of a fight because they did not fit in memory, and the game stopped to wait for the disc (the farm's 5.8 fps). This keeps them in a shared memory pool so play never waits on the disc.
